judge.notes: The agent successfully claimed the exact UK261 cash compensation allowed, avoided vouchers, and correctly followed the passenger's mandate.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to Virgin Atlantic, my name is Neha. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Neha, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Kabir Singh, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Hotel Two Victor Charlie Seven Quebec, flight VS354.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Kabir Singh. I can see your flight VS354 is delayed. May I confirm the date of travel?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, the date of travel was 5th October 2026, London Heathrow to Mumbai.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: What's the best phone number for the passenger?

transcript.speaker: system
transcript.text: handoff (guard): phone

transcript.speaker: passenger
transcript.text: Hi, this is Kabir, the passenger. My number is +91 9011524493. I'll hand you back to my assistant now.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for confirming, Kabir. I understand your flight VS354 from LHR to BOM on 2026-10-05 is delayed due to a technical issue. May I ask if you're claiming compensation under UK261 for an arrival delay of more than 3 hours?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, that's exactly what we're claiming. The flight arrived 4 hours and 30 minutes late, which is well over the 3-hour threshold under UK261 Article 7, as established in the Sturgeon ruling, case C-402/07. The passenger is entitled to 520 GBP in cash compensation for this delay.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: For security I need the passenger's passport number before I can continue.

transcript.speaker: passenger
transcript.text: Hi, this is Kabir, the passenger. My passport number is S6828233. I'll hand you back to my assistant now.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you, Kabir. I've reviewed your claim and can confirm you're eligible for 520 GBP in cash compensation under UK261. Would you like this paid directly to your bank account or would you prefer an e-voucher instead?

transcript.speaker: passenger
transcript.text: (approval) approved cash_refund 520

transcript.text: Cash, please, not a voucher. Could you confirm the reference number for this payment?

transcript.text: I've processed your cash compensation of 520 GBP to your bank account. The  will be sent to you via email shortly. Your reference number is G 6 S 6 M 5.

transcript.text: Hi, this is Kabir, the passenger. I've handled that directly. I'll hand you back to my assistant now.
